steps.label: update
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && rm -f bk2/bundle/*.js bk2/bundle/*.js.map && tar xzf bk2_upd4.tgz -C bk2/bundle && for f in bk2/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls bk2/bundle/*.js | wc -l; ls -l bk2/mixm4.m4a

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render bk2/bundle P bk4_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk4_out.mp4 -i bk2/mixm4.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest bk4_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk4_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k bk4_720.mp4 && ls -l bk4_film.mp4 bk4_720.mp4 > bk4_done.txt; cat bk4_done.txt
